title.text:
One real window: 2025-05-13 12:00-16:00 file time (12:00 UTC start), the regression of 2025-05 and its trades
6 non-overlapping top-10% trades, 4 won, mean +2.0 bps gross per trade in this window (an illustration, not an estimate: the whole month's top-10% trades at the next open averaged +0.72 bps, win rate 54%). The model fades
stretched moves: it sells after a run above the band and buys after a drop below it. Data: Bitstamp BTC/USD 1-minute history (the cut file; not Binance).
